title: 42% of California voter names flagged by Trump admin not on rolls: Analysis
description:
More than 4 in 10 names flagged as possible noncitizen voters in California by the Trump administration cannot even be found on the state's voter rolls, according to a legal filing Saturday by an immigrant rights group.
It's the first outside analysis of a list that the Department of Justice has used to threaten prosecution of election officials.
The analysis also found that thousands of US citizens appear to be flagged as ineligible to vote on the government's list.
The contention was made in a filing by two UCLA data scientists who analysed the 20,930 names that the department demanded that California election officials treat as possible illegal voters by separating their ballots during the vote count on Election Day.
Multiple judges have rejected the demand as unconstitutional and a threat to democracy, and local and state officials have said the list appears riddled with errors.
